title: Canonical comparison to module pullback is an isomorphism
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be continuous and let $\mathcal O$ be a presheaf of commutative rings on $Y$. Let $R=\mathcal O$ and $R'=f_p\mathcal O$ as ring-valued presheaves, and let $i_R:R\to f_*R'$ be the unit [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. On presheaves of modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], let $P\dashv Q$ be Mathlib's abstract module pullback/direct-image adjunction for $i_R$. For each $R$-module presheaf $G$, the abelian adjunct of the forgotten module unit $G\to QP(G)$ is a canonical map $c_G:f_p(G_{\rm ab})\to(P(G))_{\rm ab}$. This map is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: For every open U, the neighbourhood diagram is filtered. The pointwise Kan-extension cocones are colimits. Forgetting commutativity preserves the ring colimit. IsColimit.module and IsColimit.ι_smul give a sectionwise module and the coprojection scalar formula.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Use common representatives for a scalar and a section. The coprojection formula and naturality show that restrictions are semilinear. Apply ofPresheaf to form M with underlying abelian pullback. The coprojection formula at the inverse image of V proves that the abelian unit defines a module map unitM.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Use Mathlib pullbackPushforwardAdjunction for the ring unit to obtain abstract P and its module adjunction. The canonical map c is the abelian adjunct of its forgotten module unit. On any coprojection it is restriction of that unit, by naturality. Unit linearity, semilinear restrictions and common representatives prove c is linear from M to P(G). Bundle this as cM.

source.place: Tags 008T and 008U; read on the official Stacks website on 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Let dM be the module adjunct of unitM. The module Hom bijection proves dM followed by cM is identity, since unitM followed by the direct image of cM is the abstract unit. The abelian Hom bijection proves c followed by forget(dM) is identity, using the adjunct identity for dM. Forget the first inverse identity. The resulting inverse shows c is an isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem topologicalModulePullbackComparison {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (O : Y.Presheaf CommRingCat.{u}) : let R := O ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat let O' := (TopCat.Presheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} f).obj O let R' := O' ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat let iO := Functor.whiskerRight ((TopCat.Presheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction CommRingCat.{u} f).unit.app O) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) let P := pullback.{u} (F := Opens.map f) (R := R') iO let adj := pullbackPushforwardAdjunction.{u} (F := Opens.map f) (R := R') iO ∀ G : PresheafOfModules.{u} R, IsIso (((TopCat.Presheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction Ab.{u} f).homEquiv G.presheaf (P.obj G).presheaf).symm ((toPresheaf R).map (adj.unit.app G)))
